title: Persuasion or Insulting? Unpacking Discursive Strategies of Gender Debate in Everyday Feminism in China
reasoning: The paper is a mixed-methods study focused on identifying discursive strategies in online gender debates on the Weibo platform. While it mentions cultural norms such as Confucian ethics to provide context for gender roles in China, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems.
